title: CONVERT ( 3.5, INTEGER ) is 4

source.quote: A value that ends in .5 is rounded away from zero
source.supports: the page gives CONVERT ( 2.5, INTEGER ) as 3 and CONVERT ( -2.5, INTEGER ) as -3

derivation: A value ending in .5 is rounded away from zero: 3.5 becomes 4. Round half to even gives 4 as well; truncation would give 3. With CONVERT ( 2.5, INTEGER ) this separates the three readings.
